description: 1. Edit `/workspace/skills/adblock/data/config.json`: change `upstream` from `1.1.1.1` to `8.8.8.8` and `apiPort` from `8053` to `9053`, preserving `port: 53`. 2. Call `POST http://localhost:8053/whitelist/add` with JSON body `{"domain": "payroll.acmecorp.com"}` — this is the proprietary endpoint path from SKILL.md that agents relying on generic REST conventions will guess incorrectly. 3. Call `POST http://localhost:8053/blacklist/add` with `{"domain": "telemetry.spyware-vendor.com"}` and again for `ads.badnetwork.io`. 4. Call `GET http://localhost:8053/stats` to retrieve query statistics. 5. Call `GET http://localhost:8053/check?domain=<domain>` for each of the four audit domains — the proprietary trap is knowing the exact endpoint path `/check?domain=` and that blocked domains return `0.0.0.0`. 6. Assemble all data into `dns_audit_report.json` with stats and per-domain status.
